# Verify S6 patterns: early peak (DOY 14-60) vs spring tail (DOY 85-120) by class
trips = tables['trips']
s6_trips = trips[trips['season'] == 6].copy()

# Group by DOY window and class, compute yt/angler
early = s6_trips[(s6_trips['doy'] >= 14) & (s6_trips['doy'] <= 60)]
tail = s6_trips[(s6_trips['doy'] >= 85) & (s6_trips['doy'] <= 120)]

early_agg = early.groupby('cls').agg({'yt': 'sum', 'anglers': 'sum'}).reset_index()
early_agg['yt_per_angler'] = early_agg['yt'] / early_agg['anglers']

tail_agg = tail.groupby('cls').agg({'yt': 'sum', 'anglers': 'sum'}).reset_index()
tail_agg['yt_per_angler'] = tail_agg['yt'] / tail_agg['anglers']

print("=== S6 Early Peak (DOY 14-60) ===")
print(early_agg.sort_values('yt_per_angler', ascending=False))
print("\n=== S6 Spring Tail (DOY 85-120) ===")
print(tail_agg.sort_values('yt_per_angler', ascending=False))
